mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.3% in the next month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 5 trading days due to increased uncertainty and reduced corporate investment.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1pp in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.3% in the trigger period, or the rise is less than 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and fall in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >2% and INDPRO falls >1% in the same month
failure_condition: The combined GDPC1/INDPRO movement does not occur as specified, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in CPIAUCSL below 2% predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as inflation expectations normalize.
candidate_trigger: any period classified as late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods when CPIAUCSL drops below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Continued growth in employment (PAYEMS) above 1.5% month-over-month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained employment growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 1% monthly increase in GDPC1 above its recent average triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate stronger economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >1% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive despite GDPC1 exceeding the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When demand (GDPC1) increases by >2% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) decreases by >0.1pp in the same month, this dovish demand environment drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >2% and FEDFUNDS decreases >0.1pp in the same month
failure_condition: The combined GDPC1/FEDFUNDS movement does not occur as specified, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime, a sustained drop in INDPRO below 100.5 (from recent 101.894) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as scarcity drives price increases.
candidate_trigger: any period classified as supply shock regime
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during supply shocks when INDPRO drops below 100.5.
